method: Per scope, fresh tmp_path MemoryStore, 500 inserts per round, 3 repeats, mean of run totals reported in ms; per-call mean = total / n.

before.label: write-path master (no dedup)
before.note: On master, the 'duplicate' round is just a second batch of identical-content inserts; no dedup branch fires, every call appends a fresh row.

notes: Unique-insert mean regression is 1.07x of master, comfortably within the 1.20x budget set in dedup-noise.md §9.2.
Duplicate-insert per-call cost increases by 0.149 ms absolute (0.253 -> 0.402); this is the cost of the indexed SELECT, supersedes-edge INSERT, and decay UPDATE inside the same transaction.
Both absolute means are well under the 1.0 ms (unique) and 2.0 ms (duplicate) targets called out in dedup-noise.md §9.2.
The read path is unchanged (no code edits in retrieval.py); the canonical read benchmark belongs to verify-and-record (latency_before.json / latency_after.json).
